dct_title_s: Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) Economic Areas
dct_description_sm: Abstract: The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA)database is a Geographic polygon dataset representing county based economic regions for the United States.
Purpose: The database provides locational information for use in national and regional cartographic and spatial analysis applications.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: None. Acknowledgment of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics National Transportation Atlas Database would be appreciated in products derived from these data.
Data credit: The data set was compiled by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics from the NTAD county database.
